title: Related Questions

answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 55269 Country: India Title: namaz Question: What are the timings of chast salah? Answer ID: 55269 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1633/1364/B=10/1435) The time of chast salah starts 20 minutes after sunrise and remains until Zawal. However, it is better and mustahab to offer it when one fourth day is passed. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
